items.Title: AI Intern (Summer 2027)
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Position Summary

Vertiv's MindOps team is looking for a motivated intern or recent graduate to help accelerate how our engineering organization builds, tests, and ships products using AI. Working alongside Core Engineering, you'll drive adoption of AI-powered tools across software, firmware, and hardware teams, build intelligent agents that automate repetitive engineering and business work, and measure the business impact of those tools for executive leadership.

Responsibilities
  • Design AI agents that run multi-step workflows across email, Teams, GitLab, and SharePoint
  • Build agents that review code and merge requests
  • Automate test documentation and end-of-line test workflows with manufacturing and test engineering teams
  • Create reusable training content for AI tool adoption across the organization
  • Gather data on throughput, quality, and ROI for presentations to Vertiv's executive leadership
  • Support the growth of Cursor and Grok Bot agentic agents across engineering teams
Qualifications

Required:

  • Current student or recent graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems Management, Data Science, or a related field
  • Curiosity about generative AI and agentic systems with eagerness to apply them to real engineering problems
  • Comfortable programming in Python or a similar language
  • Familiarity with Git and modern development tools
  • Ability to explain technical work clearly to both engineers and business leaders
  • Self-starter who learns fast and enjoys turning messy manual processes into reliable automated ones

Preferred:

  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI agent frameworks
  • Data analysis experience

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

items.ShortDescriptionStr: Vertiv's MindOps team is looking for a motivated intern or recent graduate to help speed up how our engineering organization builds, tests, and ships products using AI. You'll work alongside Core Engineering on MindOps' main goals: growing adoption of Cursor and Grok Bot agentic agents across our software, firmware, and hardware teams, building AI assistants and autonomous agents that automate repetitive engineering and business work, and measuring the business impact of those tools. Projects may include designing Grok Bot agents that run multi-step workflows across email, Teams, GitLab, and SharePoint, building agents that review code and merge requests, automating test documentation and end-of-line test workflows with our manufacturing and test engineering teams, creating reusable training content, and gathering data on throughput, quality, and return on investment for presentations to Vertiv's executive leadership.
